sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Plague Bonus Dispute**: The core conflict arose when mill owners decided to withdraw the 'Plague Bonus' (given during the 1917 plague) despite high inflation caused by WWI.
• **The Demand**: Workers demanded a 50% wage hike; mill owners offered 20%. Gandhi intervened, suggesting a compromise of 35%.
• **Satyagraha Mechanism**: Gandhi introduced the 'Hunger Strike' as a weapon of last resort to exert moral pressure on the mill owners, specifically Ambalal Sarabhai.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The strike was the first instance where Gandhi successfully mediated between capital and labor, establishing the principle of 'Trusteeship'.

rows: Industrial/Labor dispute in Ahmedabad textile mills

items.definition: A temporary allowance provided to workers to prevent them from leaving Ahmedabad during the 1917 plague epidemic.
Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association, founded by Gandhi and Anasuya Sarabhai, based on the principle of arbitration.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Arbitration**: Gandhi insisted on a tribunal to settle disputes, avoiding prolonged strikes.
• **Trusteeship**: The belief that mill owners are 'trustees' of the wealth, not absolute owners, and must share profits with labor.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Balancing the interests of the nationalist bourgeoisie (mill owners) with the working class.
• **Solutions**: Institutionalizing labor rights through formal unions and legal arbitration frameworks.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: 'C-K-A' (Champaran, Kheda, Ahmedabad).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Chronological order of Gandhi's early Satyagrahas (1917, 1918, 1918). Ahmedabad is the only one involving industrial labor.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the Ahmedabad Mill Strike with the Kheda Satyagraha. Remember: Ahmedabad = Industrial/Urban/Mill Workers; Kheda = Agrarian/Peasant/Revenue.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Trusteeship' to explain Gandhi's economic philosophy regarding the relationship between capital and labor.

keyTakeaways: The strike was the first time Gandhi used a hunger strike as a political tool.
It led to the establishment of the Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association, a model for peaceful labor-management relations.
It solidified Gandhi's influence over the urban working class, expanding his base beyond the peasantry.
